original_sources: The v0 northern/southern source MD5-verified results and registry-blind v1 new original source results; no new GPS data or inference thresholds in this algebraic recomputation.
identity: Mean cos(B-A) = E[cosB]E[cosA]+E[sinB]E[sinA]+Cov(cosB,cosA)+Cov(sinB,sinA) within each original animal-year, preserved under equal-year and animal means.
ecological_interpretation: Observed signed solar-relative travel bearings can reflect distinct compass-marginal composition and paired position/time structure across source populations, even when the same species shows a raw sign flip. JOINT circular covariance still includes clock, migration, habitat and sampling effects; it is not animal use of solar cues. MARGINAL is not automatically caused by routes, which remain unmeasured. Dominant magnitude labels are descriptive only. No joint-bootstrap interval for the decomposition or population-independent p-value has been computed.
